observation_summary: The library failed to correctly handle dates before year zero (BC) when converting from java.util.Calendar or java.util.Date objects, resulting in incorrect year values.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves modifying the computational logic used to derive the year from the input Calendar/Date objects. Specifically, it adds logic to check the ERA field and adjust the year calculation for BC dates, and adds a conditional check for negative time values to delegate to the corrected calendar-based logic. This is a procedural correction to the conversion algorithm rather than a simple missing guard or a design-level capability gap.
evidence_used: The fix modifies the year calculation formula: (era == GregorianCalendar.AD ? yearOfEra : 1 - yearOfEra)
The fix adds a conditional check for date.getTime() < 0 to handle BC dates differently
The failing tests show incorrect year values (e.g., 0001 instead of 0000) for BC dates

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the fix adds conditional checks (if statements), the primary purpose is to correct the mathematical calculation of the year, which is an algorithmic concern.
The fix is not just about initializing a variable, but about implementing the correct logic to derive the year value based on the era.
